programs.description: Manohar and Uma are a happily married couple with two children. One day, Uma learns about her husband's extramarital affair and decides to leave him taking the kids along with her.
Vishvanath and Sudha's lives take an ugly turn when they lose their only son in a train bombing. Sudha has a nervous breakdown and Vishvanath takes it upon himself to help his wife.
